Yahoo now lets people search just by talking to Yahoo Scout, its new AI answer engine.

Once people could talk, they stopped typing keywords and started asking full questions. Sessions got longer, and conversations went deeper.

This is what search looks like when technology adapts to people. Built on ElevenAgents.
